RICHMOND

Virginia Mental Health Professional Charged in $49M Medicaid Fraud Scheme

The indictment charges her with one count of conspiracy to commit health care fraud and three counts of health care fraud.
She remains in federal custody in Richmond. The case is prosecuted by the Justice Department’s Health Care Fraud Section and the U.S. Attorney’s Office for the Eastern District of Virginia. An indictment is an allegation; every defendant is presumed innocent until proven guilty beyond a reasonable doubt at trial.
